templates.title: Overall Verification
templates.description: Verification reports (No. 1/2) should be created at the beginning of eaeach semester. Once the project is published, the purpose of these 2 report is to monitor the TCE dates.

items.instruction: Create a new report selecting the corresponding Project or Copy an existing one from a previous term selecting the correct project.
Make sure is Group by ACADEMIC_TERM
Make sure the following options are Check: Distributed, Export, Automatic Update
Info Tab - Content. Review the Title of the Report
Info Tab - Content. Review the Report Description
Info Tab - Content. Select the right Category (Term)
Info Tab - Content. Select the right Subcategory (Project)
Info Tab - Content. Review the Individual Report Title
Info Tab - Content. Select Audience as Private
Info Tab - Options. Make sure Active-Submitted checkbox is checked
Content Tab - Blocks. Add a section Type Report Block. Check the Title and the Text to display. And Select the Section Title radio button.
Content for Export Tab. Add all the Columns - see Guide for more details.
Filters Tab - Subject. Make sure the right filters were added. (ACADEMIC_TERM)
Groups Tab – Group Selection. Make sure to  “Select All Groups”
Viewers Tab Do not select any viewers. Admin-only report
Distribution Tab - Check the Start Date
Distribution Tab - Turn Off Expiry Date
Distribution Tab - Check Email Settings, Email Title, Message
Publish Tab - Uncheck the "Include PDF" option.
Publish Tab - Make sure the option "Turn off report email notification" is checked
Publish Tab - Generate the Report
Publish Tab - Click "Download File" to view the report.

items.instruction: Create a new report selecting the corresponding Project or Copy an existing one from a previous term selecting the correct project.
Make sure is Group by CLASS_COLLEGE

Info Tab - General - Configure your report experience
Review the Title of the Report
Review the Report Description
Select the right Category - Term

Text to display should be: $EXP($Click here to download the verification report $)EXP$

Add all the Columns - see Guide for more details.
Hide rows with blank or filtered out responses and Do not display question stats options should be unchecked

Set the ACADEMIC_TERM filter
Groups Tab - Group Selection
Click "Select All Groups"
Viewers Tab
Make sure to select "All Contacts" and click on Populate

Set Expiry Date to end of project

Update Publish Date. Turn off Report Expiry Date.
Set Stop Sync Date to Project end date
Generate Report and review samples
Validate the Report and review errors/warnings
Publish the report

Select all Instructor specific blocks and group into a virtual question (Instructor Specific vq1). Repeat with Course specific blocks (Course Specific vq1)

Triggers should copy from previous projects, but details can be found in the TCE Reports document in Teams.
Filters Tab - Subject
Add: ACADEMIC_TERM is  [  ], type the current term for the value

Select Group: Instructors and click on Populate > Confirm. Check "Users" are populated by spot checking "Edit viewers" for a few entries.
Impact of Static Viewer Removal should be "No Effect"

Activate all: College Assessment, Department Assessment, Course Coordinator and enable Receive notification emails
Click "Get Latest"
Distribution Tab
Set a Fixed Start Date (First business day of week around 9am)
Turn off Report Expiry Date
Review Email settings to turn on email notifications and check dates and details in the email subject and body.
Require authentication should be checked

Update Publish date: The FAQ says ~3 weeks after the end of the semester/session. Turn off Expiry Date
Validate the report and review warnings/errors
Generate the report (this will take a while)

Click Publish to publish the reports. Individual reports will only become available one the Distribution date has passed, even if the report is published.
